summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature in the repository, but nothing has been run: tests, Black, and imports are unverified, per the instructions to work by reading and editing only. Changes: added SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member to ControlCode (rich/segment.py); added the title formatting entry and the Control.title classmethod (rich/control.py); added Console.set_window_title beside show_cursor, returning True only when the control was buffered and False when not a terminal (rich/console.py); added the SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch in the legacy renderer, calling term.set_title once with the second item (rich/_windows_renderer.py); added an Unreleased "Added" changelog bullet linking pull request 2200 (CHANGELOG.md). Added three tests: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). Nothing was committed. One choice to review: the Console test skip is keyed on sys.platform rather than the legacy_windows flag.
